title: WeWorkTogether - Web3 Cross-Border Freelance Platform
description: A secure freelance collaboration platform with AI-assisted milestone planning and automated GitHub workflow orchestration.

story.problem: Freelance collaboration across borders required manual project planning, fragmented onboarding, and weak execution visibility.
story.approach: I integrated AI-assisted planning with automated repository workflows to reduce setup friction and speed up delivery.
story.architecture: Built with Next.js App Router and Prisma, secured with JWT, bcrypt, and RBAC, then connected to GitHub APIs and webhooks for repo creation, onboarding, and commit tracking.
story.results: Teams could move from idea to structured execution much faster, with project planning time reduced by 60%.
